translation: Wanti tokko hin tauu: waan tokkotti isa hin baafu — waan tokkoof lafti hawaa taatee, bishanii Madda bishaan jalaa baafamuu akka hin tauuf. Ani tokkotti isaan siif dura baafu miti, akkasumas bishanichaan siif dura baafu miti; wanti tokko yoo taate, lafti duwwaa taatee, biyya Madda bishaanii taatee isarratti baay'achuu qabda miti — ani yeroo tokko keessatti isaan si duraa baafu miti, akka lafti hawaa hin taaneefii, akka bineensonni marmartuu bishaanii ta'an siif dura hin baay'anneef.
